intro.title: Tiger Eye Bracelets
intro.descriptionHtml: Collection of Tiger Eye Bracelets made from natural Red and Brown Tiger Eye Gemstone Beads in a variety of designs. The Bracelets look excellent in Cuboid, Drum, Square etc Bead shapes. Buddha Bracelets, powerful Rudraksha beads with Tiger Eye Bracelets, Tiger Eye and other Gemstone combination Bracelets and others. The Tiger Eye Gemstone is highly protective, provides integrity, the truth about self and situation, brings money, good luck and more. It also balances the Muladhara(Root) Chakra brining stability.
